title: Regime Slicing Prioritizer (RSP): multi-horizon RICE + latency-cost bands
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Purpose: introduce a reproducible prioritization rubric that combines RICE-style scoring with explicit token-economics and latency SLO penalties across distinct traffic regimes. Motivation: existing RICE snapshots miss nonlinear cost and latency impacts for high-throughput features and undervalue low-volume, high-quality experiences. RSP segments candidate initiatives into operational regimes (Burst, Steady, Tail) and applies regime-specific multipliers plus a latency penalty factor and capacity multiplier so teams can compare apples-to-apples when planning OKR-aligned roadmaps.

Core concepts: 
- Regimes: categorize work by expected QPS & tokens-per-request: Burst (spiky, high peak), Steady (predictable mid-volume), Tail (low-volume but high impact per-request).
- Base RICE: Reach * Impact * Confidence / Effort (standard), but with Impact expressed as expected product value per-1000 tokens (token-econ-adjusted).
- Latency Penalty Factor (LPF): continuous penalty proportional to expected p95 overshoot relative to SLO; higher latency sensitivity for user-facing features.
- Capacity Multiplier (CM): models whether a feature needs Dedicated vs Hosted capacity, and multiplies effective effort/cost to reflect reserved capacity economics.
- Regime Weight (RW): manually tuned to reflect strategic priorities for the cycle (e.g., prioritize Steady revenue features this cycle).

When to use: roadmap scoring, cycle trade-offs where both token-cost and latency risk materially change the unit economics of a feature, pre-commit stage for Dedicated capacity buy decisions.

Outputs: a ranked list of initiatives per-regime and global normalized score, plus a short justification for rollout mode (hosted vs dedicated) and a recommended canary plan for latency-sensitive launches.
acceptance_criteria: Framework doc reviewed and approved by PM and infra lead
Example scoring applied to top 25 backlog items with numeric outputs exported to roadmap CSV
Scoring reproducer (spreadsheet or small script) in repo with instructions and sample inputs
At least one pilot initiative re-scored with telemetry-derived p95 and cost estimates and included in next cycle plan

notes: Trade-offs: raising RegimeWeight for Steady increases near-term revenue capture but can starve Tail work that improves long-term product quality.
Decision: default regime weights for Q2 set to {Burst: 0.9, Steady: 1.2, Tail: 1.3} to prioritize stable revenue while preserving quality investments.
Confidence handling: apply a floor of 0.3 to Confidence to avoid extreme amplification of low-data items.
Cost handling: use on-the-book reserved pricing for Dedicated CM estimates, and spot/hosted market rates for Hosted cost baseline.
calculations_example: AdjustedScore = Base RICE * RegimeWeight * (1 - LPF) / CM

Numeric example: Reach=20k users/month, Impact_token_adjusted=0.08 value per 1000 tokens, Confidence=0.7, Effort=5 points => Base RICE= (20k * 0.08 * 0.7)/5 = 224.
If expected_p95=420ms, SLO=250ms, latency_sensitivity_weight=0.5 => LPF= clamp(0,0.7,((420-250)/250)*0.5)=0.34.
If expected_tokens_per_min=150k, capacity_threshold=200k, cost_sensitivity=0.6 => CM=1 + (150k/200k)*0.6=1.45.
AdjustedScore=224 * 1.2 * (1 - 0.34) / 1.45 = ~129.
